1  简介1  Introduction

发现具有目标特性的新型、可合成和多样化的晶体材料仍然是材料科学的中心目标The discovery of novel, synthesizable, and diverse crystalline materials with targeted properties remains a central goal of materials science(Merchant et al., 2023)。然而，可能的组合物和结构的搜索空间是巨大的，而只有一小部分候选物是热力学稳定的。传统的计算方法可以系统地探索这个空间. Yet the search space of possible compositions and structures is combinatorially vast, while only a small fraction of candidates is thermodynamically stable. Traditional computational approaches can explore this space systematically(Pickard and Needs, 2011; Oganov and Glass, 2006)。然而，即使拥有大型高吞吐量基础设施. However, even with large high-throughput infrastructures(Jain et al., 2013; Curtarolo et al., 2012; Kirklin et al., 2015)，候选评估仍然通常依赖于密度泛函理论（DFT）, candidate evaluation still typically relies on density functional theory (DFT)(Kohn and Sham, 1965; Jones, 2015)，其传统的 Kohn-Sham 实现在计算上仍然昂贵，具有电子或基函数数量的三次标度, whose conventional Kohn–Sham implementations remain computationally expensive have cubic scaling with the number of electrons or basis functions(Goedecker, 1999).

深度生成模型通过学习直接从数据提出候选材料，提供了一种有前途的替代方案Deep generative models offer a promising alternative by learning to propose candidate materials directly from data(Xie et al., 2021; Zeni et al., 2025)。然而，在晶体生成中，问题的几何和对称结构已促使许多文献转向等变图神经网络（GNN）和其他专用架构. In crystal generation, however, the geometric and symmetry structure of the problem has driven much of the literature toward equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs) and other specialized architectures(Luo et al., 2025; Jiao et al., 2024a; Zeni et al., 2025; Miller et al., 2024)。虽然非常有效，但这些方法在架构上可能很复杂并且计算要求很高，这促使人们寻找更简单的骨架，但仍能捕获足够的晶体几何形状以保持竞争力. While highly effective, these approaches can be architecturally complex and computationally demanding, motivating the search for simpler backbones that still capture enough crystal geometry to remain competitive(Yang et al., 2024)。这就提出了一个自然的问题：轻量级转换器能否恢复足够的几何结构来在没有显式等变消息传递的情况下进行竞争？. This raises a natural question: can a lightweight transformer recover enough geometric structure to compete without explicit equivariant message passing?

最近的研究表明，Transformer 可以与基于 GNN 的晶体生成方法相媲美。特别是，扩散变压器已成为原子和晶体发电的一种有前途的轻量级替代品Recent work suggests that transformers can be competitive with GNN-based approaches for crystal generation. In particular, diffusion transformers have emerged as a promising lightweight alternative for atomistic and crystalline generation(Yi et al., 2025; Joshi et al., 2025; Jin et al., 2025)。然而，这些方法通常仅弱或间接地结合晶体几何结构，从而使标准扩散变换器是否可以保持简单，同时受益于更直接的周期性几何结构注入尚不确定。. However, these approaches often incorporate crystal geometry only weakly or indirectly, leaving open whether a standard diffusion transformer can remain simple while benefiting from a more direct injection of periodic geometric structure.

在这项工作中，我们介绍In this work, we introduce微晶Crystalite，一种用于晶体材料的轻质扩散变压器。 Crystalite 通过周期性和几何偏差增强了标准多头注意力，并使用紧凑的化学信息原子表示来代替高维单热类型编码。这保留了标准变压器骨干的简单性和可扩展性，同时提高了其对晶体生成的适用性。, a lightweight diffusion transformer for crystalline materials. Crystalite augments standard multi-head attention with periodic and geometric biases, and uses a compact chemically informed atom representation in place of high-dimensional one-hot type encodings. This preserves the simplicity and scalability of a standard transformer backbone while improving its suitability for crystal generation.

我们的主要贡献如下：Our main contributions are as follows:

  • •

    我们引入了几何增强模块（GEM），这是一种轻量级的注意力偏置机制，它将周期性和成对几何直接注入到标准 Transformer 中，为等变消息传递提供了一种有效的替代方案。We introduce the Geometric Enhancement Module (GEM), a lightweight attention-biasing mechanism that injects periodic and pairwise geometry directly into standard Transformers, providing an efficient alternative to equivariant message passing.

  • •

    我们用一种更适合连续扩散的紧凑的化学信息表示取代单热原子类型。We replace one-hot atom types with a compact chemically informed representation that is better matched to continuous diffusion.

  • •

    我们证明 Crystalite 实现了最先进的晶体结构预测和We show that Crystalite achieves state-of-the-art crystal structure prediction and从头de novo生成性能，同时采样速度比几何密集的基线快得多。generation performance, while sampling much faster than geometry-heavy baselines.

  • •

    我们描述了新颖性、有效性和稳定性之间的权衡，并表明基于 MLIP 的稳定性估计为模型选择提供了实用的信号。We characterize the trade-off between novelty, validity, and stability, and show that MLIP-based stability estimates provide a practical signal for model selection.

2  相关工作2  Related Work

先前关于晶体生成的工作在几何结构的处理方式上有很大不同。其中一项研究通过等变或几何感知架构将对称性和周期性直接构建到模型中。另一项探索了较轻的主干，包括具有较弱感应偏置的变压器。微晶与最近的扩散变压器系列关系最为密切，但在几何信息的整合方式上有所不同。Prior work on crystal generation differs largely in how geometric structure is handled. One line of research builds symmetry and periodicity directly into the model through equivariant or geometry-aware architectures. Another explores lighter backbones, including transformers, with weaker inductive bias. Crystalite is most closely related to the recent diffusion-transformer line, but differs in how geometric information is incorporated.

等变和几何感知晶体发生器。Equivariant and geometry-aware crystal generators.

扩散模型Diffusion models(Ho et al., 2020; Song and Ermon, 2019)已成为原子领域生成建模的强大框架。在晶体材料中，一种常见的策略是将扩散与等变 GNN 结合起来，因为晶体结构自然地允许基于图形的表示，并且受到重要的几何对称性的控制（参见附录have become a powerful framework for generative modeling in atomistic domains. In crystalline materials, a common strategy is to combine diffusion with equivariant GNNs, since crystal structures naturally admit graph-based representations and are governed by important geometric symmetries (see AppendixA）。物质生成器). MatterGen(Zeni et al., 2025)例如，是一个基于 GemNet 构建的高性能等变扩散模型, for example, is a high-performing equivariant diffusion model built on GemNet(Gasteiger et al., 2021)联合模拟原子类型、分数坐标和晶格参数，也可以适用于逆向设计。 EGNNthat jointly models atom types, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, and can also be adapted for inverse design. EGNN(Satorras et al., 2021)，如 DiffCSP 中所用, as used in DiffCSP(Jiao et al., 2024a)，同样成为后续几种方法的支柱, has likewise served as the backbone for several subsequent approaches(Miller et al., 2024; Hoellmer et al., 2025; Cornet et al., 2025; Luo et al., 2025)。这些作品还探索了日益专业化的生成公式，以更好地处理晶体几何形状。流MM. These works also explore increasingly specialized generative formulations to better handle crystal geometry. FlowMM(Miller et al., 2024)，例如，扩展了黎曼流匹配, for instance, extends Riemannian flow matching(Chen and Lipman, 2024)到分数坐标，同时to fractional coordinates, whileHoellmer et al. (2025)使用随机插值研究此设置study this setting using stochastic interpolants(Albergo et al., 2025)。 KLDM. KLDM(Cornet et al., 2025)相反，通过使用环面的李群结构将噪声过程提升到辅助平坦空间来处理周期性分数坐标。总的来说，这些方法显示了强几何归纳偏差的价值，但通常以增加架构和计算复杂性为代价。instead handles periodic fractional coordinates by lifting the noising process to an auxiliary flat space using the Lie group structure of the torus. Collectively, these methods show the value of strong geometric inductive bias, but often at the cost of increasing architectural and computational complexity.

完全等变的轻量级替代方案。Lightweight alternatives to full equivariance.

最近的一项工作询问是否可以在没有完全等效架构的情况下实现材料生成的强大性能。这些方法很有吸引力，因为它们通常更简单、计算效率更高并且更容易扩展。尤尼马特A more recent line of work asks whether strong performance in material generation can be achieved without fully equivariant architectures. These approaches are attractive because they are typically simpler, more computationally efficient, and easier to scale. UniMat(Yang et al., 2024)例如，表明基于 3D U-Net 的扩散模型可以与等变基线保持竞争力，并从增加的模型规模中受益。更广泛地说，基于变压器的方法也在自回归和混合设置中进行了探索，包括晶体表示的序列模型, for example, shows that a diffusion model based on a 3D U-Net can remain competitive with equivariant baselines and benefit from increased model scale. More broadly, transformer-based approaches have also been explored in autoregressive and hybrid settings, including sequence models over crystal representations(Mohanty et al., 2024; Kazeev et al., 2025; Gruver et al., 2025; Cao et al., 2025)以及语言模型提供晶体先验的管道，这些先验随后由更结构化的几何生成器进行细化and pipelines in which language models provide crystal priors that are later refined by more structured geometric generators(Khastagir et al., 2025; Sriram et al., 2024)。这些结果表明，完全等变的消息传递可能并不总是必要的，但它们保留了晶体生成器应直接编码多少几何图形。. These results suggest that fully equivariant message passing may not always be necessary, but they leave open how much geometry a crystal generator should encode directly.

用于原子和晶体生成的扩散变压器。Diffusion transformers for atomistic and crystal generation.

与我们最接近的工作是最近针对分子、材料和晶体的扩散变换器方法。阿迪特The works closest to ours are recent diffusion-transformer approaches for molecules, materials, and crystals. ADiT(Joshi et al., 2025)采用潜扩散变压器employs a latent diffusion transformer(Peebles and Xie, 2023; Rombach et al., 2022)具有最小的感应偏置，可在分子和材料上联合生成，同时with minimal inductive bias for joint generation over molecules and materials, whileMorehead et al. (2026)用更简单的扩散变换器公式扩展这个方向。奥克斯塔尔extend this direction with a simpler diffusion-transformer formulation. OXtal(Jin et al., 2025)将扩散变换器应用于金属有机框架的晶体结构预测，并将其与 EDM 式预处理和采样相结合applies diffusion transformers to crystal structure prediction for metal-organic frameworks and combines this with EDM-style preconditioning and sampling(Karras et al., 2022)，而水晶迪特, while CrystalDiT(Yi et al., 2025)将扩散变换器类型的模型引入晶体生成。 Crystalite 最直接地构建在这方面的工作上，但不同之处在于它将周期性成对几何直接注入注意力，而不是仅仅依赖于增强或潜在空间结构。从这个意义上说，我们的目标不是消除几何归纳偏差，而是将其纳入比完全等变 GNN 更简单、更模块化的形式中。brings the diffusion-transformer type of model to crystalline generation. Crystalite builds most directly on this line of work, but differs in that it injects periodic pairwise geometry directly into attention rather than relying only on augmentation or latent-space structure. In this sense, our goal is not to remove geometric inductive bias, but to incorporate it in a simpler and more modular form than in fully equivariant GNNs.

3  方法论3  Methodology

Crystalite 是围绕一个简单的想法构建的：保持去噪主干靠近标准扩散变压器，并通过表示、注意力机制和采样程序合并特定于晶体的结构。我们从原子特性、分数坐标和晶格几何的晶体标准晶胞描述开始。在此表示之上，我们用化学结构标记替换单热原子恒等式，联合定义原子、坐标和晶格变量上的扩散，并使用每个原子使用一个标记和单个全局晶格标记的 Transformer 处理结果状态。然后，可以通过几何增强模块（GEM）将周期性成对几何直接注入注意力，同时通道级反退火启发式改进了采样时的细化。Crystalite is built around a simple idea: keep the denoising backbone close to a standard diffusion Transformer, and incorporate crystal-specific structure through the representation, attention mechanism, and sampling procedure. We begin from the standard unit-cell description of a crystal in terms of atom identities, fractional coordinates, and lattice geometry. On top of this representation, we replace one-hot atom identities with chemically structured tokens, define diffusion jointly over atom, coordinate, and lattice variables, and process the resulting state with a Transformer that uses one token per atom together with a single global lattice token. Periodic pairwise geometry can then be injected directly into attention through the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM), while a channel-wise anti-annealing heuristic improves refinement at sampling time.

3.1  化学结构原子代币3.1  Chemically Structured Atom Tokens

标准表示使用单热原子型矩阵A standard representation uses the one-hot atom-type matrix𝐀∈{0,1}N×NZ\mathbf{A}\in\{0,1\}^{N\times N_{Z}}。我们发现这种选择对于晶体材料上的扩散来说不是最佳的，原因有两个。首先，对于真实的材料数据集. We found this choice suboptimal for diffusion over crystalline materials for two reasons. First, for realistic materials datasetsNZN_{Z}可以很大（例如can be large (e.g.NZ=89N_{Z}=89MP-20 上），使得原子型通道相对于基础化学变量来说不必要地高维。其次，单热几何在化学上是无信息的：所有元素都是相互正交的，因此，例如，Li 与 Na 的距离和与 Xe 的距离一样远。这可以鼓励模型记住重复出现的成分，同时不提供平滑的化学相似性的概念。on MP-20), making the atom-type channel unnecessarily high-dimensional relative to the underlying chemical variable. Second, the one-hot geometry is chemically uninformative: all elements are mutually orthogonal, so for example, Li is as far from Na as it is from Xe. This can encourage the model to memorize recurring compositions, while providing no notion of smooth chemical similarity.

为了解决这个问题，我们用低维连续标记化取代了单热通道，我们将其称为To address this, we replace the one-hot channel by a low-dimensional continuous tokenization, which we refer to as亚原子标记化Subatomic Tokenization。对于每个支持的元素. 𝐇=[𝐡a1,…,𝐡aN]⊤∈ℝN×dH,\mathbf{H}=\big[\mathbf{h}_{a_{1}},\dots,\mathbf{h}_{a_{N}}\big]^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d_{H}}, (3)

哪里wheredHd_{H}表示可选 PCA 压缩后的标记维度。这种设计有两个目的。首先，它降低了原子型通道的维数，这使得去噪在统计上更容易，并降低了模型记忆频繁组成模式的能力。其次，它为扩散过程配备了具有化学意义的几何形状：亚原子空间中的错误变得结构化，因此在噪声下，模型被鼓励在不相关的物种之前将元素与看似合理的替代物混淆。denotes the token dimension after optional PCA compression. This design serves two purposes. First, it reduces the dimensionality of the atom-type channel, which makes denoising statistically easier and lowers the capacity of the model to memorize frequent compositional patterns. Second, it equips the diffusion process with a chemically meaningful geometry: errors in subatomic space become structured, so that under noise the model is encouraged to confuse elements with plausible substitutions before unrelated species.

亚原子标记化在我们的 EDM 公式中尤其自然，因为原子类型被视为连续扩散变量以及分数坐标和晶格参数。因此，降噪器不需要在高维类单纯形空间中恢复稀疏的单热向量，而是返回低维化学标记。在采样过程中，去噪后的标记Subatomic Tokenization is especially natural in our EDM formulation, since atom types are treated as continuous diffusion variables jointly with fractional coordinates and lattice parameters. The denoiser therefore does not need to recover a sparse one-hot vector in a high-dimensional simplex-like space, but instead returns a low-dimensional chemical token. During sampling, the denoised token𝐡^i\hat{\mathbf{h}}_{i}通过最近令牌解码映射回离散元素，is mapped back to a discrete element by nearest-token decoding,

a^i=arg⁡maxk∈{1,…,NZ}⁡⟨𝐡^i,𝐡k⟩,\hat{a}_{i}=\arg\max_{k\in\{1,\dots,N_{Z}\}}\langle\hat{\mathbf{h}}_{i},\mathbf{h}_{k}\rangle, (4)

这相当于余弦相似度解码，因为所有标记向量都已标准化。这使得训练和解码几何结构保持一致。在晶体结构预测 (CSP) 设置中，成分已知，亚原子矩阵保持固定，仅对坐标和晶格通道进行去噪。我们在附录中提供了有关此嵌入的更多信息which is equivalent to cosine-similarity decoding because all token vectors are normalized. This keeps the training and decoding geometries aligned. In the crystal structure prediction (CSP) setting, where the composition is known, the subatomic matrix is held fixed and only the coordinate and lattice channels are denoised. We provide additional information on this embedding in AppendixB.1.

3.2  晶体的扩散公式3.2  Diffusion formulation for crystals

从一块水晶开始Starting from a crystal𝒞=(𝐀,𝐅,𝐋)\mathcal{C}=(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{F},\mathbf{L})，我们定义连续扩散状态, we define a continuous diffusion state

而不是扩散原始晶格矩阵Rather than diffusing the raw lattice matrix𝐋∈ℝ3×3\mathbf{L}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times 3}直接地，我们通过一个下三角潜伏来表示它directly, we represent it through a lower-triangular latent𝐲∈ℝ6\mathbf{y}\in\mathbb{R}^{6}并重建and reconstruct

𝐋​(𝐲)=[ey100y2ey30y4y5ey6].\mathbf{L}(\mathbf{y})=\begin{bmatrix}e^{y_{1}}&0&0\\ y_{2}&e^{y_{3}}&0\\ y_{4}&y_{5}&e^{y_{6}}\end{bmatrix}. (5)

这产生了具有正对角线条目的稳定的无约束表示，并减少了晶格通道中的表示冗余。因此，扩散模型在连续元组上运行This yields a stable unconstrained representation with positive diagonal entries and reduces representational redundancy in the lattice channel. The diffusion model therefore operates on the continuous tuple(𝐇,𝐅,𝐲)(\mathbf{H},\mathbf{F},\mathbf{y}).

然而，晶格表示仍然依赖于基础。为了减少基础模糊性，我们将每个结构预处理为 Niggli-reduced 单元，并在标记化之前以固定的晶格参数约定来表达晶格。在训练期间，唯一显式的晶体增强是分数坐标的随机全局平移；我们不会增加格基排列或其他等效的单元选择。The lattice representation remains basis-dependent, however. To reduce basis ambiguity, we preprocess each structure into a Niggli-reduced cell and express the lattice in a fixed lattice-parameter convention before tokenization. During training, the only explicit crystal augmentation is a random global translation of the fractional coordinates; we do not augment over lattice-basis permutations or other equivalent cell choices.

3.4  几何增强模块（GEM）3.4  Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM)

Crystalite 通过依赖于几何形状的加性偏差增强了标准自注意力，并在每个去噪步骤中重新计算。 该设计在精神上与图形转换器（例如 Graphormer）中使用的附加结构偏差相关Crystalite augments standard self-attention with a geometry-dependent additive bias, recomputed at each denoising step. This design is related in spirit to additive structural biases used in graph transformers such as Graphormer(Ying et al., 2021)，但这里的偏置是由周期性最小图像晶体几何结构构成的。 这将周期性的成对结构注入到注意力机制中，而不需要等变消息传递，如图所示, but here the bias is constructed from periodic minimum-image crystal geometry. This injects periodic pairwise structure into the attention mechanism without requiring equivariant message-passing, as shown in Figure1.

给定分数坐标Given the fractional coordinates𝐅\mathbf{F}和晶格潜伏and lattice latent𝐲\mathbf{y}，我们重建晶格矩阵, we reconstruct the lattice matrix𝐋​(𝐲)\mathbf{L}(\mathbf{y})。对于每个原子对. For each atom pair(i,j)(i,j)，我们计算最小图像分数位移, we compute the minimum-image fractional displacementΔ​𝐟i​j⋆\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}^{\star}在周期性边界条件及其归一化笛卡尔距离下：under periodic boundary conditions and its normalized Cartesian distance:

d¯i​j=‖Δ​𝐟i​j⋆​𝐋​(𝐲)‖2s​(𝐲),\bar{d}_{ij}=\frac{\|\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}^{\star}\mathbf{L}(\mathbf{y})\|_{2}}{s(\mathbf{y})}, (14)

哪里wheres​(y)s(y)是特征细胞尺度；在我们的实现中，我们使用三个晶格长度的平均值。与坐标损失中使用的包裹分数残差不同，GEM 通过最小化由晶格度量引起的笛卡尔二次形式来选择周期图像is a characteristic cell scale; in our implementation we use the mean of the three lattice lengths. Unlike the wrapped fractional residual used in the coordinate loss, GEM selects the periodic image by minimizing the Cartesian quadratic form induced by the lattice metric𝐆=𝐋𝐋⊤\mathbf{G}=\mathbf{L}\mathbf{L}^{\top}.

根据该几何形状，GEM 通过将直接距离惩罚与学习到的边缘特征相结合来构造头部注意力偏差。然后通过学习的噪声相关门来调制这种组合偏差From this geometry, GEM constructs a head-wise attention bias by combining a direct distance penalty with learned edge features. This combined bias is then modulated by a learned noise-dependent gategh​(σ)g_{h}(\sigma)形成最终的几何偏差：to form the final geometric bias:

Bh​i​jgeom=gh​(σ)​(Bh​i​jdist+Bh​i​jedge)B^{\mathrm{geom}}_{hij}=g_{h}(\sigma)\left(B^{\mathrm{dist}}_{hij}+B^{\mathrm{edge}}_{hij}\right) (15)

其中距离惩罚where the distance penaltyBh​i​jdist=wh​d¯i​jB^{\mathrm{dist}}_{hij}=w_{h}\bar{d}_{ij}使用学习的、单调非正斜率uses a learned, monotonically non-positive slopewh≤0w_{h}\leq 0，边缘偏差通过 MLP 模拟非线性交互：, and the edge bias models non-linear interactions through an MLP:

Bh​i​jedge=MLPedge([γΔ(Δ𝐟i​j⋆),γd(d¯i​j),ψ(𝐲)])h.B^{\mathrm{edge}}_{hij}=\operatorname{MLP}_{\mathrm{edge}}\!\left(\left[\gamma_{\Delta}(\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}^{\star}),\gamma_{d}(\bar{d}_{ij}),\psi(\mathbf{y})\right]\right)_{h}. (16)

在这里，Here,γΔ\gamma_{\Delta}将傅里叶特征应用于位移，applies Fourier features to the displacement,γd\gamma_{d}对距离应用径向基函数 (RBF) 内核，并且applies a Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel to the distance, andψ​(𝐲)\psi(\mathbf{y})是一个低维晶格描述符。is a low-dimensional lattice descriptor.

这种几何偏差仅适用于原子-原子相互作用。填充This geometric bias is applied exclusively to atom–atom interactions. Padding𝐁geom\mathbf{B}^{\mathrm{geom}}对于涉及全局格标记的任何交互为零，注意力更新变为：with zeros for any interactions involving the global lattice token, the attention update becomes:

Attn⁡(Q,K,V)=softmax⁡(Q​K⊤d+𝐁geom)​V.\operatorname{Attn}(Q,K,V)=\operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\frac{QK^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}+\mathbf{B}^{\mathrm{geom}}\right)V. (17)

这使得模型能够直接在注意力逻辑中强调几何兼容的原子对，同时保持标准扩散变压器的简单性和效率。我们在附录中提供了有关实施的更多详细信息This allows the model to emphasize geometrically compatible atom pairs directly in the attention logits while maintaining the simplicity and efficiency of a standard diffusion Transformer. We provide more details on the implementation in AppendixC.2.

3.5  采样期间逐通道反退火。3.5  Channel-wise anti-annealing during sampling.

在 EDM 采样期间，我们可以选择应用During EDM sampling, we optionally apply a通道级反退火channel-wise anti-annealing步骤，分别重新调整原子标记、坐标和晶格通道的逆时更新。直观上，这充当与通道相关的时间扭曲：如果特定通道去噪速度更慢或主导剩余误差，则反退火驱动器会更积极地引导去噪预测，同时使学习的去噪器本身保持不变。这对于我们在不修改训练目标的情况下改进采样时的几何细化的设置特别有用。具体来说，对于每个通道step, which rescales the reverse-time update separately for the atom-token, coordinate, and lattice channels. Intuitively, this acts as a channel-dependent time warp: if a particular channel denoises more slowly or dominates the remaining error, anti-annealing drives that channel more aggressively toward the denoised prediction while leaving the learned denoiser itself unchanged. This was particularly useful in our setting for improving geometric refinement at sampling time without modifying the training objective. Concretely, for each channelq∈{H,F,lat}q\in\{H,F,\mathrm{lat}\}，我们将标准 Heun 式 EDM 更新替换为, we replace the standard Heun-style EDM update by

𝐳i+1(q)=𝐳¯i(q)+(σi+1−σ¯i)​αi(q)​𝐝i(q)+𝐝i+1(q),E2,αi(q)≥1,\mathbf{z}_{i+1}^{(q)}=\bar{\mathbf{z}}_{i}^{(q)}+(\sigma_{i+1}-\bar{\sigma}_{i})\,\alpha_{i}^{(q)}\,\frac{\mathbf{d}_{i}^{(q)}+\mathbf{d}_{i+1}^{(q),E}}{2},\qquad\alpha_{i}^{(q)}\geq 1, (18)

哪里whereαi(q)\alpha_{i}^{(q)}是从辅助卡拉斯时间表导出的特定于通道的抗退火因子，并且is a channel-specific anti-annealing factor derived from an auxiliary Karras schedule, andαi(q)=1\alpha_{i}^{(q)}=1恢复标准 EDM 采样器。完整详细信息参见附录recovers the standard EDM sampler. Full details are given in AppendixD.1，以及附录中消除反退火对 DNG 影响的其他结果, and additional results ablating the effect of anti-annealing on DNG in AppendixF.

4  实验设置4  Experimental Setup

4.1  数据集4.1  Datasets

我们使用三个现实数据集来对模型进行基准测试：MP-20We use three realistic datasets to benchmark the models: MP-20(Xie et al., 2021)，材料项目的一个子集, a subset of the Materials Project(Jain et al., 2013)包含 45 231 个晶体材料，每个晶胞最多有 20 个原子，具有 89 种不同的原子类型； MPTS-52containing 45 231 crystalline materials of up to 20 atoms per unit cell with 89 distinct atom types; MPTS-52(Baird et al., 2024)其中每个分割均按时间顺序从材料项目中导出，包含 40 476 个结构，每个晶胞最多有 50 个原子 - 值得注意的是，时间成分增加了额外的难度，其中训练、验证和测试集在其基础分布中表现出根本性的转变，使得该基准特别具有挑战性；和亚历克斯-MP-20where each split is derived chronologically from the Materials Project and contains 40 476 structures with up to 50 atoms per unit cell – notably the temporal component adds an extra degree of difficulty where the training, validation, and test sets exhibit a fundamental shift in their underlying distributions, making this benchmark particularly challenging; and Alex-MP-20(Zeni et al., 2025)其中包含 675 204 个结构，每个晶胞最多有 20 个原子，源自 Alexandria 和 MP-20。这里我们遵循下式给出的数据分割which contains 675 204 structures with up to 20 atoms per unit cell, derived from Alexandria and MP-20. Here we follow the data splits as given byHoellmer et al. (2025).

4.2  任务设置4.2  Task setup

我们在两种设置下评估 Crystalite：We evaluate Crystalite in two settings:从头de novo生成（DNG）和晶体结构预测（CSP）。在 DNG 设置中，模型从噪声中联合生成原子类型、分数坐标和晶格参数。在 CSP 设置中，提供原子成分作为输入，模型仅预测晶体几何形状，即分数坐标和晶格。在操作上，这是通过将化学结构的原子标记固定到已知的成分并掩盖训练和采样期间的类型损失来实现的。generation (DNG) and crystal structure prediction (CSP). In the DNG setting, the model generates atom types, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters jointly from noise. In the CSP setting, the atomic composition is provided as input, and the model predicts only the crystal geometry, i.e. the fractional coordinates and lattice. Operationally, this is implemented by fixing the chemically structured atom tokens to the known composition and masking the type loss during training and sampling.

模型设置。Model settings.

We train inbfloat16并维持参数的指数移动平均线（EMA）；所有报告的抽样和评估结果均使用 EMA 权重。除非另有说明，我们还在基准测试中使用相同的 EDM 采样设置，包括and maintain an exponential moving average (EMA) of the parameters; all reported sampling and evaluation results use the EMA weights. For each model, we use the largest sampling batch size that fits in memory, so that each method is evaluated at its highest feasible throughput. 5  结果与讨论5  Results and Discussion

5.1  CSP 结果5.1  CSP Results

表Table1总结了 CSP 基准测试的结果。在所有数据集上，Crystalite 的性能均优于之前的方法。使用匹配率来评估成功的结构恢复，使用 RMSE 来测量几何精度（参见附录summarizes the results on the CSP benchmarks. Across all datasets, Crystalite outperforms prior methods. Using Match Rate to assess successful structure recovery and RMSE to measure geometric accuracy (see AppendixE.1），Crystalite 在这两个标准上均取得了最先进的结果。 RMSE 的改善尤其明显，表明即使在基于比赛的表现已经很强的环境中，结构恢复也更加准确。), Crystalite achieves state-of-the-art results on both criteria. The improvement is especially pronounced in RMSE, indicating more accurate structural recovery even in settings where match-based performance is already strong.

附录中的消融研究更详细地检验了 GEM 的效果The effect of GEM is examined in more detail in the ablation study in AppendixF.3。我们发现 GEM 对匹配率的影响有限，同时不断提高几何精度，在整个实验中将 RMSE 降低约 20%。这表明GEM主要是细化局部原子排列和整体结构保真度，而不是影响是否恢复正确的结构模式。. We find that GEM has only a limited impact on Match Rate, while consistently improving geometric accuracy, reducing RMSE by approximately 20% across experiments. This indicates that GEM primarily refines local atomic arrangements and overall structural fidelity, rather than affecting whether the correct structural mode is recovered.

5.2  DNG结果5.2  DNG Results

表Table2总结了主要内容summarizes the main从头de novo生成结果。在比较方法中，Crystalite 实现了最高的 SUN 率和最快的采样速度。自从generation results. Crystalite achieves the highest SUN rate and the fastest sampling speed among the compared methods. Since从头de novo发电量从根本上取决于稳定性和多样性之间的权衡，我们将 SUN 视为主要汇总指标。其余报告的指标可分为两大类：generation is fundamentally governed by a trade-off between stability and diversity, we treat SUN as the primary summary metric. The remaining reported metrics can be grouped into two broad categories:质量和多样性quality and diversity指标，以及metrics, and稳定性和分布stability and distribution指标，详见附录metrics, which are described in detail in AppendixE.1。然而，在实践中，这些量是紧密耦合的，因此模型的选择在很大程度上取决于优先考虑性能的哪个方面。如图. In practice, however, these quantities are tightly coupled, so model selection depends strongly on which aspect of performance is prioritized. As shown in Figure4，训练会带来明显的权衡。随着优化的进行，模型与训练分布更加匹配，这往往会提高有效性、稳定性和分布一致性，但同时会降低新颖性和独特性。直观上，分布更匹配的模型生成的结构更容易稳定，化学上更合理，但也更有可能重复以前见过的化学式和结构基序。, training induces a clear trade-off. As optimization progresses, the model more closely matches the training distribution, which tends to improve validity, stability, and distributional alignment, but at the same time reduces novelty and uniqueness. Intuitively, a more distribution-matched model generates structures that are easier to stabilize and more chemically plausible, yet also more likely to repeat previously seen chemical formulas and structural motifs.

这种权衡尤其明显，因为原子类型是与坐标和晶格参数联合建模的，因此很难独立于结构质量来控制成分记忆。缓解这种情况的一种简单而有效的方法是大幅减轻原子类型的损失。图This trade-off is especially pronounced because atom types are modeled jointly with coordinates and lattice parameters, making it difficult to control compositional memorization independently of structural quality. One simple and effective way to mitigate this is to substantially downweight the atom-type loss. Figure4结果表明，当原子型预测任务以这种方式变得更加困难时，SUN 指标会逐渐饱和，但在训练期间保持稳定的时间更长。相比之下，随着损失重量更加均匀，稳定性和稳定、独特和新型晶体 (SUN) 的百分比一开始会迅速提高，但一旦模型开始记住化学式，就会恶化。这也使得检查点选择更加脆弱。因此，我们选择显着降低原子型损失的权重，从而实现更平滑、更稳定的训练动态。shows that when the atom-type prediction task is made harder in this way, the SUN metric saturates more gradually, but remains stable for longer during training. By contrast, with more evenly balanced loss weights, stability and percentage of stable, unique and novel crystals (SUN) improve rapidly at first, but then deteriorate once the model begins to memorize chemical formulas. This also makes checkpoint selection more fragile. We therefore choose to significantly downweight the atom-type loss, which leads to smoother and more stable training dynamics.

这种行为反映在评估指标中。结构有效性、组成有效性、稳定性和基于 Wasserstein 的分布指标通常会随着训练时间的延长而提高，特别是当模型开始更紧密地拟合训练分布时。相比之下，同一时期的独特性、新颖性以及随之而来的联合国比率往往会下降。因此，我们认为 DNG 评估从根本上来说是由以下因素之间的权衡决定的：This behavior is reflected across the evaluation metrics. Structural validity, compositional validity, stability, and Wasserstein-based distribution metrics generally improve with longer training, particularly once the model begins to fit the training distribution more closely. In contrast, uniqueness, novelty, and consequently the UN rate tend to decrease over the same period. We therefore view DNG evaluation as fundamentally governed by a trade-off between稳定性stability和and多样性diversity。因此，我们在主表中强调 SUN 指标，因为它直接体现了这些竞争目标之间的平衡。 GEM 消融研究中进一步分析（附录. For this reason, we emphasize the SUN metric in the main table, since it directly captures the balance between these competing objectives. As further analyzed in the GEM ablation study (AppendixF.2），GEM 主要改进了这种权衡的稳定性，从而带来更高的稳定性，从而在整个训练过程中持续提高 SUN 率。), GEM mainly improves the stability side of this trade-off, leading to higher stability and consequently a consistently higher SUN rate throughout training.

模型之间的公平性和可比性。Fairness and comparability between models.

我们的主要评估流程使用基于 NequIP 的松弛Our primary evaluation pipeline uses NequIP-based relaxation(Batzner et al., 2022)以及基于 SUN 的检查点选择。为了公平起见，主表中报告的所有基线结果都是通过评估同一管道中的竞争方法获得的，而不是通过表面价值获取公布的数字。然而，由于这些方法最初可能是在不同标准下进行训练和检查的，因此验证 Crystalite 不会从我们的设置中获得不成比例的好处仍然很重要。因此，我们还在外部基准测试管道（即 MatterGen）下评估 Crystalitetogether with SUN-based checkpoint selection. For fairness, all baseline results reported in the main tables were obtained by evaluating the competing methods within this same pipeline, rather than by taking published numbers at face value. Nevertheless, since those methods may originally have been trained and checkpointed under different criteria, it remains important to verify that Crystalite does not benefit disproportionately from our setup. We therefore also evaluate Crystalite under external benchmarking pipelines, namely the MatterGen(Zeni et al., 2025)评估流程和 LeMat GenBenchevaluation pipeline and LeMat GenBench(Betala et al., 2026);相应的结果报告在表中; the corresponding results are reported in Table3和附录表and Appendix Table5.

广泛而密集的指标。Extensive and intensive metrics.

In 从头de novo随着生成样本数量的增加，评估指标的行为方式并不相同。有些反映了单个抽取的属性，因此可以从随机子集中可靠地估计。其他人则将生成集作为一个整体来表征，并随着总采样预算而系统地变化。通过与物理学类比，我们将这些称为样本-generation, evaluation metrics do not all behave the same way as the number of generated samples increases. Some reflect properties of an individual draw and can therefore be estimated reliably from random subsets. Others instead characterize the generated set as a whole and vary systematically with the total sampling budget. By analogy with physics, we refer to these as sample-强化intensive和样品-and sample-广泛的extensive分别为指标。唯一性和衍生量（例如联合国比率）具有很强的样本扩展性：随着更多晶体的产生，重复项不可避免地会积累，因此这些指标通常会减少。metrics, respectively. Uniqueness, and derived quantities such as the UN rate, are strongly sample-extensive: as more crystals are generated, duplicates inevitably accumulate, so these metrics typically decrease.

这种依赖性在实践中很重要，因为有用的晶体发生器不仅应该产生合理的结构，而且还应该继续大规模发现许多独特的和以前未见过的候选者。因此，我们在图中比较了 Crystalite 和 ADiTThis dependence matters in practice, since a useful crystal generator should not only produce plausible structures, but should also continue to discover many distinct and previously unseen candidates at scale. We therefore compare Crystalite and ADiT in Figure5作为生成晶体数量的函数，表明随着采样规模的扩大，Crystalite 可以更有效地保留多样性。更广泛地说，这表明样本广泛的指标应始终与生成的样本总数一起报告，因为它们的值在不同预算中不能直接比较。我们在附录中进一步讨论这个问题as a function of the number of generated crystals, showing that Crystalite preserves diversity more effectively as sampling is scaled up. More broadly, this suggests that sample-extensive metrics should always be reported together with the total number of generated samples, since their values are not directly comparable across different budgets. We discuss this issue further in AppendixE.3，我们将区别形式化，并阐明哪些指标可以、哪些不能从子集中可靠地估计。, where we formalize the distinction and clarify which metrics can, and cannot, be reliably estimated from subsets.

6  结论6  Conclusion

我们推出了 Crystalite，一种用于晶体结构预测的轻量级扩散变压器We introduced Crystalite, a lightweight diffusion Transformer for crystal structure prediction and从头de novo水晶一代。通过将化学结构原子令牌与几何增强模块 (GEM) 相结合，Crystalite 将晶体特定的感应偏置注入标准 Transformer，而不依赖于昂贵的等变消息传递。crystal generation. By combining chemically structured atom tokens with the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM), Crystalite injects crystal-specific inductive bias into a standard Transformer without relying on expensive equivariant message passing.

在各个基准测试中，Crystalite 实现了最先进的晶体结构预测性能和强大的Across benchmarks, Crystalite achieves state-of-the-art crystal structure prediction performance and strong从头de novo生成结果，在评估的基线中获得最佳 SUN 分数，同时采样速度比几何密集的替代方案快得多。这些结果表明，只要以正确的方式合并周期性几何结构和化学结构，强大的晶体建模性能不一定需要完全等变。总体而言，Crystalite 提供了一种简单而有效的晶体建模方法，并表明轻量级扩散变压器是可扩展材料发现的一个有前途的方向。generation results, attaining the best SUN score among the evaluated baselines while sampling substantially faster than geometry-heavy alternatives. These results show that strong crystal modeling performance does not necessarily require full equivariance, provided that periodic geometry and chemical structure are incorporated in the right way. Overall, Crystalite offers a simple and efficient approach to crystal modeling and suggests that lightweight diffusion Transformers are a promising direction for scalable materials discovery.

A.1  晶体的晶胞表示A.1  Unit-cell representation of crystals

理想情况下，晶体材料是三维空间中原子的无限周期性排列，如图所示A crystalline material is, ideally, an infinite periodic arrangement of atoms in three-dimensional space, as shown in Figure6。与其逐个原子地描述完整的固体原子，不如指定一个单一的. Rather than describing the full solid atom by atom, it suffices to specify a single晶胞unit cell以及该单元在晶格的整数平移下重复的规则。这是整篇论文中使用的标准表示法。together with the rule that this cell repeats under integer translations of the lattice. This is the standard representation used throughout the paper.

周期性边界条件。Periodic boundary conditions.

分数坐标位于平面圆环上Fractional coordinates live on the flat torus

𝕋3≅(ℝ/ℤ)3,\mathbb{T}^{3}\cong(\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^{3}, (22)

意思是meaning that𝐟\mathbf{f}和and𝐟+𝐧\mathbf{f}+\mathbf{n}代表任何相同的物理位置represent the same physical position for any𝐧∈ℤ3\mathbf{n}\in\mathbb{Z}^{3}。这正是周期性边界条件：离开晶胞一个面的原子通过相反的面重新进入。. This is precisely the periodic boundary condition: atoms leaving one face of the unit cell re-enter through the opposite face.

因此，通过将每个基础原子平移所有整数晶格位移来生成完整的无限晶体：The full infinite crystal is therefore generated by translating each basis atom by all integer lattice shifts:

𝐱i,𝐧=(𝐟i+𝐧)​𝐋,𝐧∈ℤ3.\mathbf{x}_{i,\mathbf{n}}=(\mathbf{f}_{i}+\mathbf{n})\mathbf{L},\qquad\mathbf{n}\in\mathbb{Z}^{3}. (23)

因此，有限晶胞描述隐含地定义了整个周期性材料。A finite unit-cell description thus implicitly defines the entire periodic material.

包裹残差和度量感知的最小图像几何。Wrapped residuals and metric-aware minimum-image geometry.

由于分数坐标是周期性的，因此几何量必须遵循环面结构。在坐标损失中，我们使用分数空间中的分量包裹残差，Because fractional coordinates are periodic, geometric quantities must respect the torus structure. In the coordinate loss, we use the componentwise wrapped residual in fractional space,

使得每个组成部分so that each component of𝜹i​jwrap\bm{\delta}^{\mathrm{wrap}}_{ij}在于lies in[−12,12)[-\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{1}{2})。相关的笛卡尔位移和距离为. The associated Cartesian displacement and distance are

然而，在几何增强模块（GEM）中，我们不使用组件式包装。相反，我们在点阵度量下使用度量感知的周期性图像搜索。写作In the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM), however, we do not use componentwise wrapping. Instead, we use a metric-aware periodic-image search under the lattice metric. Writing

并将搜索限制为有限的晶格偏移集and restricting the search to a finite set of lattice offsetsΩR={−R,…,R}3\Omega_{R}=\{-R,\dots,R\}^{3}，我们定义, we define

Δ​𝐟i​j⋆=arg⁡min𝐫∈ΩR⁡(𝐟i−𝐟j+𝐫)​𝐆​(𝐟i−𝐟j+𝐫)⊤,\Delta\mathbf{f}^{\star}_{ij}=\arg\min_{\mathbf{r}\in\Omega_{R}}(\mathbf{f}_{i}-\mathbf{f}_{j}+\mathbf{r})\,\mathbf{G}\,(\mathbf{f}_{i}-\mathbf{f}_{j}+\mathbf{r})^{\top}, (27)

对于正交单元，这两种结构一致，但对于一般非正交单元，它们不需要等效。因此，在整篇论文中，我们区分了坐标损失中使用的包裹分数残差和 GEM 中使用的度量感知最小图像几何结构。当我们提到最小图像几何时，我们指的是后一种结构。For orthogonal cells these two constructions coincide, but for general non-orthogonal cells they need not be equivalent. Throughout the paper, we therefore distinguish between the wrapped fractional residual used in the coordinate loss and the metric-aware minimum-image geometry used in GEM. When we refer to minimum-image geometry, we mean the latter construction.

A.2  对称性和表示非唯一性A.2  Symmetries and representation non-uniqueness

同一物理晶体可以允许多种等效表示。因此，晶体上的目标分布应遵循多种对称性。在主要论文的符号中，这些可以直接表达为The same physical crystal can admit multiple equivalent representations. As a result, the target distribution over crystals should respect several symmetries. In the notation of the main paper, these can be expressed directly in terms of(𝐀,𝐅,𝐋)(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{F},\mathbf{L}).

原子索引的排列。Permutation of atom indices.

晶胞内的原子顺序是任意的。对于任意置换矩阵The ordering of atoms inside the unit cell is arbitrary. For any permutation matrixP∈𝒫NP\in\mathcal{P}_{N},

p​(𝐀,𝐅,𝐋)=p​(P​𝐀,P​𝐅,𝐋).p(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{F},\mathbf{L})=p(P\mathbf{A},\;P\mathbf{F},\;\mathbf{L}). (29)

笛卡尔空间中的全局旋转。Global rotation in Cartesian space.

整个晶体的刚性旋转仅改变笛卡尔坐标系，而不改变底层材料。根据我们的行向量约定，这对应于晶格矩阵的右乘。对于任何旋转A rigid rotation of the entire crystal changes only the Cartesian frame, not the underlying material. Under our row-vector convention, this corresponds to right multiplication of the lattice matrix. For any rotationR∈S​O​(3)R\in SO(3),

p​(𝐀,𝐅,𝐋)=p​(𝐀,𝐅,𝐋​R).p(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{F},\mathbf{L})=p(\mathbf{A},\;\mathbf{F},\;\mathbf{L}R). (30)

格基的排列。Permutation of the lattice basis.

格基向量的选择不是唯一的。在对分数坐标应用逆排列的同时排列晶格基会使笛卡尔晶体保持不变。对于任何The choice of lattice basis vectors is not unique. Permuting the lattice basis while applying the inverse permutation to the fractional coordinates leaves the Cartesian crystal unchanged. For anyS∈𝒫3S\in\mathcal{P}_{3},

p​(𝐀,𝐅,𝐋)=p​(𝐀,𝐅​S⊤,S​𝐋).p(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{F},\mathbf{L})=p(\mathbf{A},\;\mathbf{F}S^{\top},\;S\mathbf{L}). (31)

环面上的全局翻译。Global translation on the torus.

将所有分数坐标移动同一环面元素不会改变晶体。对于任何Shifting all fractional coordinates by the same torus element does not change the crystal. For any𝐭∈𝕋3\mathbf{t}\in\mathbb{T}^{3},

p​(𝐀,𝐅,𝐋)=p​(𝐀,wrap⁡(𝐅+𝟏​𝐭⊤),𝐋),p(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{F},\mathbf{L})=p\!\big(\mathbf{A},\;\operatorname{wrap}(\mathbf{F}+\mathbf{1}\mathbf{t}^{\top}),\;\mathbf{L}\big), (32)

哪里where𝟏∈ℝN\mathbf{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{N}表示全1向量。denotes the all-ones vector.

这些对称性激发了 Crystalite 的多种设计选择。特别是，我们用分数坐标表示位置，使用包裹的周期性残差进行坐标去噪，在 GEM 中使用度量感知的最小图像几何形状，并在训练期间应用随机全局平移以鼓励近似平移等方差。These symmetries motivate several of the design choices in Crystalite. In particular, we represent positions in fractional coordinates, use wrapped periodic residuals for coordinate denoising, use metric-aware minimum-image geometry in GEM, and apply random global translations during training to encourage approximate translation equivariance.

因此，Crystalite 对每个原子使用一个标记，以及一个总结全局晶胞几何形状的附加标记。Thus Crystalite uses one token per atom, together with one additional token that summarizes the global unit-cell geometry.

这种调节通过自适应层归一化 (AdaLN) 注入到每个 Transformer 块中。This conditioning is injected into every Transformer block through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN).

然后，令牌序列由具有堆叠自注意力和前馈块的标准 Transformer 主干进行处理。写作The token sequence is then processed by a standard Transformer trunk with stacked self-attention and feed-forward blocks. 在最后一个块之后，浅输出头将更新的原子标记映射到去噪原子类型和坐标预测，并将晶格标记映射到去噪晶格潜在：After the final block, shallow output heads map the updated atom tokens to denoised atom-type and coordinate predictions, and the lattice token to the denoised lattice latent:

因此，原子量是根据位点标记来预测的，而全局晶格参数是根据晶格标记来预测的。Thus atom-wise quantities are predicted from the site tokens, while the global lattice parameters are predicted from the lattice token.

C.2  几何增强模块（GEM）C.2  Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM)

GEM 通过源自当前晶体几何形状的成对几何偏差增强了自注意力。它不会改变标记化或预测头；相反，它通过加性偏差张量修改注意力逻辑。GEM augments self-attention with pairwise geometric biases derived from the current crystal geometry. It does not change the tokenization or prediction heads; instead, it modifies the attention logits through an additive bias tensor.

给定当前分数坐标Given the current fractional coordinates𝐅\mathbf{F}和晶格潜伏and lattice latent𝐲\mathbf{y}，GEM首先重构点阵矩阵, GEM first reconstructs the lattice matrix𝐋​(𝐲)\mathbf{L}(\mathbf{y})并计算周期性边界条件下的成对最小图像几何形状。让and computes pairwise minimum-image geometry under periodic boundary conditions. Let

𝐆​(𝐲)=𝐋​(𝐲)​𝐋​(𝐲)⊤\mathbf{G}(\mathbf{y})=\mathbf{L}(\mathbf{y})\mathbf{L}(\mathbf{y})^{\top} (50)

表示相应的度量张量。对于每对原子denote the corresponding metric tensor. For each pair of atoms(i,j)(i,j)，我们考虑周期性偏移, we consider periodic offsets𝐫∈ΩR={−R,…,R}3\mathbf{r}\in\Omega_{R}=\{-R,\dots,R\}^{3}并定义and define

Δ​𝐟i​j​(𝐫)=𝐟i−𝐟j+𝐫.\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}(\mathbf{r})=\mathbf{f}_{i}-\mathbf{f}_{j}+\mathbf{r}. (51)

然后选择最小图像位移为The minimum-image displacement is then chosen as

Δ​𝐟i​j⋆=arg⁡min𝐫∈ΩR⁡Δ​𝐟i​j​(𝐫)​𝐆​(𝐲)​Δ​𝐟i​j​(𝐫)⊤,\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}^{\star}=\arg\min_{\mathbf{r}\in\Omega_{R}}\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}(\mathbf{r})\,\mathbf{G}(\mathbf{y})\,\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}(\mathbf{r})^{\top}, (52)

与相应的笛卡尔距离with corresponding Cartesian distance

di​j=‖Δ​𝐟i​j⋆​𝐋​(𝐲)‖2.d_{ij}=\big\|\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}^{\star}\mathbf{L}(\mathbf{y})\big\|_{2}. (53)

在实践中，该距离通过特征单元尺度进行归一化In practice, this distance is normalized by a characteristic cell scales​(𝐲)s(\mathbf{y})，产生, yieldingd¯i​j=di​j/s​(𝐲)\bar{d}_{ij}=d_{ij}/s(\mathbf{y}).

根据该成对几何形状，GEM 构建了两个加性偏差项。第一个是距离偏差，From this pairwise geometry, GEM builds two additive bias terms. The first is a distance bias,

Bh​i​jdist=αh​d¯i​j,αh≤0,B^{\mathrm{dist}}_{hij}=\alpha_{h}\,\bar{d}_{ij},\qquad\alpha_{h}\leq 0, (54)

它充当每个注意力头的可学习局部性先验which acts as a learnable locality prior for each attention headhh。第二个是由作用于周期性成对特征的小型 MLP 产生的边缘感知偏差，. The second is an edge-aware bias produced by a small MLP acting on periodic pairwise features,

ϕi​j=[γΔ(Δ𝐟i​j⋆),γd(d¯i​j),ψ(𝐲)],Bh​i​jedge=MLPedge(ϕi​j)h,\phi_{ij}=\big[\gamma_{\Delta}(\Delta\mathbf{f}_{ij}^{\star}),\gamma_{d}(\bar{d}_{ij}),\psi(\mathbf{y})\big],\qquad B^{\mathrm{edge}}_{hij}=\operatorname{MLP}_{\mathrm{edge}}(\phi_{ij})_{h}, (55)

哪里whereγΔ\gamma_{\Delta}和andγd\gamma_{d}表示 Fourier/RBF 特征图，denote Fourier/RBF feature maps andψ​(𝐲)\psi(\mathbf{y})是一个低维晶格描述符。is a low-dimensional lattice descriptor.

两个分支被组合，可选地由噪声相关门进行调制，The two branches are combined, optionally modulated by a noise-dependent gate,

Bh​i​j(k)=gh​(σ)​(Bh​i​jdist+Bh​i​jedge),B_{hij}^{(k)}=g_{h}(\sigma)\Big(B^{\mathrm{dist}}_{hij}+B^{\mathrm{edge}}_{hij}\Big), (56)

然后通过保持晶格-令牌相互作用无偏从原子对扩展到完整的令牌序列：and then expanded from atom pairs to the full token sequence by leaving lattice-token interactions unbiased:

𝐁~h(k)=[𝐁h(k)𝟎𝟎⊤0].\widetilde{\mathbf{B}}^{(k)}_{h}=\begin{bmatrix}\mathbf{B}_{h}^{(k)}&\mathbf{0}\\ \mathbf{0}^{\top}&0\end{bmatrix}. (57)

最后，将此偏差直接添加到注意力逻辑中，Finally, this bias is added directly to the attention logits,

Attn⁡(Q,K,V)=softmax⁡(Q​K⊤d+𝐁~(k))​V.\operatorname{Attn}(Q,K,V)=\operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\frac{QK^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}+\widetilde{\mathbf{B}}^{(k)}\right)V. (58)

这种结构让 Crystalite 将周期性几何信息直接注入注意力，同时保留标准 Transformer 主干的简单性。当 GEM 禁用时，模型使用相同的标记化、扩散目标和输出头，但具有This construction lets Crystalite inject periodic geometric information directly into attention while preserving the simplicity of a standard Transformer backbone. When GEM is disabled, the model uses the same tokenization, diffusion objective, and output heads, but with𝐁~(k)=0\widetilde{\mathbf{B}}^{(k)}=0.

C.3  基础模型配置C.3  Base model configuration

除非另有说明，本文中的主要 MP-20 DNG 结果使用表中总结的基本 Crystalite 配置Unless otherwise stated, the main MP-20 DNG results in the paper use the base Crystalite configuration summarized in Table4。该实例化大约包含. This instantiation contains approximately6.7×1076.7\times 10^{7}可训练参数。它使用一个trainable parameters. It uses a1414具有模型宽度的层变压器干线-layer Transformer trunk with model widthd=512d=512和and1616注意力头，以及具有标记维度的 PCA 压缩亚原子标记化attention heads, together with PCA-compressed Subatomic Tokenization with token dimensiondH=16d_{H}=16.

这些设置定义了整个主要实验中使用的基本模型。更广泛的实现支持替代标记化、嵌入变体和 GEM 配置，但上述规范对应于论文中报告的主要模型。These settings define the base model used throughout the main experiments. The broader implementation supports alternative tokenizations, embedding variants, and GEM configurations, but the specification above corresponds to the principal model reported in the paper.

E.3  样本量密集型和扩展型指标E.3  Sample-size intensive and extensive metrics

一个重要的实践要点An important practical point in从头de novo生成的特点是，当生成的样本数量发生变化时，并非所有指标的行为方式都相同。一些指标描述了产品的质量generation is that not all metrics behave the same way when the number of generated samples changes. Some metrics describe the quality of a典型生成的晶体typical generated crystal。其他人描述了. Others describe the discovery yield of the整个生成集entire generated set。我们将这两种情况与物理学进行类比，称为. We refer to these two cases, by analogy with physics, as样本密集型sample-intensive和and样本广泛sample-extensive指标。metrics.

样本密集型指标。Sample-intensive metrics.

如果指标的目标不强烈依赖于总发电预算，则该指标是样本密集型的A metric is sample-intensive if its target does not depend strongly on the total generation budgetnn。这些量可以根据生成的晶体的随机子集进行估计，而不会改变其含义。在我们的设置中，这包括：. These are quantities that can be estimated from a random subset of generated crystals without changing their meaning. In our setting, this includes:

  • •

    成分有效性和结构有效性，compositional validity and structural validity,

  • •

    每个样本的稳定率，per-sample stability rates,

  • •

    平均船体距离或其他每个样本的属性平均值，average hull distance or other per-sample property means,

  • •

    分布指标，例如密度上的 Wasserstein 距离或distribution metrics such as Wasserstein distances on density orNN-元统计。-ary statistics.

对于此类数量，随机子集给出相同基础目标的近似值。在最简单的情况下，如果For such quantities, a random subset gives an approximation to the same underlying target. In the simplest case, ifg​(𝒞i)g(\mathcal{C}_{i})是每个样本的分数或指标，那么is a per-sample score or indicator, then

μ^m=1m​∑i=1mg​(𝒞i)\widehat{\mu}_{m}=\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}g(\mathcal{C}_{i}) (101)

是大小子集的自然估计量is the natural estimator from a subset of sizemm.

样本广泛的指标。Sample-extensive metrics.

如果指标直接取决于生成的样本数量，则该指标是样本广泛的。在晶体生成中，每当复制物质时就会发生这种情况。随着生成预算的增长，重复碰撞变得更加常见，因此相同的模型可能看起来或多或少不同，仅取决于采样的结构数量。在我们的设置中，这包括：A metric is sample-extensive if it depends directly on how many samples were generated. In crystal generation, this happens whenever duplicates matter. As the generation budget grows, duplicate collisions become more common, so the same model can look more or less diverse depending only on how many structures were sampled. In our setting, this includes:

  • •

    独特性，uniqueness,

  • •

    已发现的不同结构的数量，the number of distinct discovered structures,

  • •

    当报告为生成集的发现产量时的新颖性，novelty when reported as a discovery yield over the generated set,

  • •

    UN\mathrm{UN},

  • •

    SUN\mathrm{SUN}.

例如，如果For example, ifNunique​(n)N_{\mathrm{unique}}(n)是绘制后生成的唯一结构的数量is the number of unique generated structures after drawingnn样本，然后samples, then

Uniquen=Nunique​(n)n,UNn=NUN​(n)n\mathrm{Unique}_{n}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{unique}}(n)}{n},\qquad\mathrm{UN}_{n}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{UN}}(n)}{n} (102)

是显式函数are explicitly functions ofnn。在较小的子集上评估这些数量确实. Evaluating these quantities on a smaller subset does不not按全部预算估算其价值。它只是以不同的预算计算相同的指标。在实践中，这通常会使独特性和相关的发现指标在小子集上人为地看起来更好。estimate their value at the full budget. It simply computes the same metric at a different budget. In practice, this usually makes uniqueness and related discovery metrics look artificially better on small subsets.

这种区别解释了为什么某些指标可以在子集上进行估计，而另一些则不能。有效性、稳定性和平均属性度量可以在随机子集上进行近似。相比之下，独特性，This distinction explains why some metrics can be estimated on subsets and others cannot. Validity, stability, and average property metrics can be approximated on random subsets. By contrast, uniqueness,UN\mathrm{UN}, 和, andSUN\mathrm{SUN}应与生成的样本数量一起报告，并仅在匹配的样本预算下进行比较。should be reported together with the number of generated samples and compared only at matched sample budgets.

需要注意的是，新颖性可以用两种不同的方式来定义。如果测试新颖性A small caveat is that novelty can be defined in two different ways. If novelty is tested每个样本per sample相对于固定的参考集，那么它的行为就像一个密集的数量。然而，在我们的设置中，新颖性被用作重复数据删除发现管道的一部分，因此将其与against a fixed reference set, then it behaves like an intensive quantity. In our setting, however, novelty is used as part of the deduplicated discovery pipeline, so it is more natural to treat it together withUN\mathrm{UN}和andSUN\mathrm{SUN}作为样本数量。as a sample-extensive quantity.

F.1  DNG MatterGen 评估流程结果F.1  DNG MatterGen evaluation pipeline results

在这里，我们展示了使用 Mattergen 评估管道进行评估时的 DNG 指标，以便我们可以在非我们设计的设置上将不同模型与我们的模型进行比较。Here we present our DNG metrics when evaluated using Mattergen evaluation pipeline, so that we can compare different models against ours on a setup that is not designed by us.

F.2  GEM 对 DNG 结果的影响F.2  GEM effect on DNG Results

图Figure11比较了带有和不带有几何增强模块（GEM）的 Crystalite 的训练动态compares the training dynamics of Crystalite with and without the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM) in the从头de novo生成设置。随着训练的进行，两种配置都表现出独特新颖（UN）率的预期下降，反映了多样性和稳定性之间的总体权衡。然而，使用 GEM 的模型在稳定性轴上的学习速度要快得多，并且在整个训练过程中保持更高的稳定性。因此，它在整个训练轨迹中也实现了持续较高的稳定、独特和新颖 (SUN) 率。这表明将周期性成对几何结构注入注意力可以提高生成晶体的结构质量，而不会导致生成多样性的不成比例的损失。generation setting. Both configurations exhibit the expected decline in the unique-and-novel (UN) rate as training progresses, reflecting the general trade-off between diversity and stability. However, the model with GEM learns substantially faster on the stability axis and maintains higher stability throughout training. As a result, it also achieves a consistently higher Stable, Unique, and Novel (SUN) rate across the full training trajectory. This suggests that injecting periodic pairwise geometry into attention improves the structural quality of generated crystals without causing a disproportionate loss in generative diversity.

F.3  GEM 对 CSP 结果的影响F.3  GEM effect on CSP Results

图Figure12显示了晶体结构预测 (CSP) 的相应烧蚀。在这里，GEM 对匹配率 (MR) 的影响不大，但在整个训练过程中使 RMSE 得到更清晰、更一致的改善。换句话说，GEM 似乎对模型是否恢复正确的结构模式影响有限，但对恢复后结构细化的准确程度影响较大。这与 GEM 引入的几何偏差主要改善去噪过程中的局部原子布局和整体结构保真度的解释是一致的。shows the corresponding ablation for crystal structure prediction (CSP). Here, GEM has only a modest effect on Match Rate (MR), but leads to a clearer and more consistent improvement in RMSE throughout training. In other words, GEM appears to have a limited effect on whether the model recovers the correct structural mode, but a stronger effect on how accurately that structure is refined once recovered. This is consistent with the interpretation that the geometric biases introduced by GEM primarily improve local atomic placement and overall structural fidelity during denoising.

F.4  DNG 抗退火敏感性F.4  DNG Sensitivity to anti-annealing

我们还消除了采样时使用的逐通道反退火设置，改变坐标和晶格通道的反退火强度，同时保持训练模型固定。We also ablate the channel-wise anti-annealing settings used at sampling time, varying the strength of anti-annealing for the coordinate and lattice channels while keeping the trained model fixed.

总体而言，结果对这种选择相当不敏感：在合理的设置范围内，主要结论保持不变，并且 Crystalite 始终表现良好。尽管一种反退火配置获得了最高的 SUN 分数，但它也产生了明显较差的 Wasserstein 距离，表明分布对齐较差。因此，我们不会报告单一的最佳 SUN 配置，而是选择一个更平衡的设置，该设置可以保留强大的发现性能，同时与参考分布保持更好的一致性。这表明反退火是一种有用但不脆弱的采样启发式方法，并且报告的结果并不严重依赖于反退火参数的微调选择。Overall, the results are fairly insensitive to this choice: across a reasonable range of settings, the main conclusions remain unchanged and Crystalite performs consistently well. Although one anti-annealing configuration achieved the highest SUN score, it also produced noticeably worse Wasserstein distances, indicating poorer distributional alignment. For this reason, we do not report the single best-SUN configuration, but instead select a more balanced setting that preserves strong discovery performance while maintaining better agreement with the reference distribution. This suggests that anti-annealing is a useful but non-fragile sampling heuristic, and that the reported results do not depend critically on a finely tuned choice of anti-annealing parameters.
